help_do: Describe something others can see or notice
help_try: Try something – the result is random
help_status: Lasting text above your head – without text it is removed
help_whisper: Whisper – only very close players see it
help_shout: Shout – players further away see it
help_rpclear: Remove RP texts and status (without ID: everyone)
help_rpmute: Block RP commands for a player
help_rpunmute: Unblock RP commands for a player
param_status_help: e.g. injured – leave empty to remove
status_usage: Usage: /{command} [text] – without text the status is removed
blocked: This text contains a blocked word.
muted: You cannot use RP commands for {minutes} more minute(s).
unmuted: You can use RP commands again.
no_permission: You are not allowed to use this command.
player_not_found: No player with ID {id} is online.
muted_player: Player {id} cannot use RP commands for {minutes} minute(s).
unmuted_player: Player {id} can use RP commands again.
cleared_player: Texts and status of player {id} removed.
cleared_all: All RP texts and statuses removed.
